channel.title: Humanoids Daily
channel.description: We bring you the latest developments in robotics, with a special focus on humanoid robots and intelligent machines. From groundbreaking research to real-world applications, we cover the people, technologies, and innovations shaping the future of robotics.

item.title: Astra, Opus and Argon Show How Frontier AI Models Are Speeding Up Robotics Development
item.description: New Astra and Opus demonstrations echo Google’s Argon workflows, accelerating simulation and controller development while exposing the need to verify generated experiments.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Dynamic Creatures Introduces Hugo, a Furry Character Robot With 43 Actuators
item.description: The startup shows Hugo in a new video and outlines work on a Vision-Language-Expression model, navigation and safety for guest interaction.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon Takes Apollo From Human Video to Seven Straight Cornhole Shots
item.description: Google demonstrates Argon using video, simulation and physical feedback to develop robot skills, alongside an 87% embodied-reasoning benchmark score.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Galbot’s PASSAGE Helps Humanoids Step Over, Duck Under and Squeeze Past Obstacles
item.description: PASSAGE learns from human motion to navigate clutter, with onboard Unitree G1 tests and distinct results for destination-reaching and contact-free traversal.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: This Week’s Newsletter: Agility’s $300M Order, Optimus Hands and Two Interviews
item.description: Our October 13 briefing explores Digit 5’s economics, Optimus’s hand challenges and our Aether and Monolithos interviews. Read it and subscribe for free.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Musk Details Optimus Hand Challenges, Warns of Slow Initial Production Ramp
item.description: At X Takeover, Musk described the hand durability and supply-chain challenges behind Optimus, saying magnet export restrictions delayed the program last year.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: South Korea Approves 20-Robot Robros Trial Across Industrial Sites
item.description: A regulatory-sandbox approval opens industrial testing for 20 Robros humanoids as the company targets a manufacturing-focused AI model in the first half of 2027.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Asimov Releases Python SDK, Announces Open-Source Edge Control Layer
item.description: Menlo Research releases a Python SDK for Asimov 1 and announces plans to open its controller-arbitration layer, extending the humanoid’s developer tools.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Google DeepMind Is Building a New Cambridge-Area Robotics Lab, Aaron Saunders Says
item.description: Former Boston Dynamics CTO Aaron Saunders says Google DeepMind is creating a new lab for its growing robotics hardware team, with more news expected in 2027.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: DeepSeek Reportedly Plans to Lead Winverse AI Seed Round at $400 Million Valuation
item.description: Bloomberg reports that DeepSeek plans to lead a seed round of tens of millions of dollars for robot-AI startup Winverse. The proposed deal is not yet finalized.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Archon Robotics Shares Debut Demo of Its Whole-Body Humanoid Intelligence
item.description: Archon Robotics introduces its Whole-Body Intelligence approach, combining human-data pretraining, robot training and coordinated motion control for legged humanoids.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: MindOn Claims 142 Garments per Hour in Hour-Long Mind-1 Folding Demo
item.description: MindOn’s latest Mind-1 video shows an extended dual-arm clothes-folding demonstration, with a counter reaching 142 and a claimed throughput of 142 garments per hour.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Unitree’s Wang Xingxing Says GPT-6 Tests Strengthen His Optimism for Embodied AI
item.description: Wang says Unitree’s GPT-6 robot tests produced encouraging results and suggests an embodied AI tipping point could arrive within one or two years in a fast scenario.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: AWS Introduces Physical AI Toolchain to Connect Robot Training and Simulation
item.description: AWS’s new toolchain connects NVIDIA robotics software with cloud infrastructure, offering reusable development modules while parts of the deployment workflow remain planned.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: China’s Humanoid Robot Rental Prices Fall as Operators Face the Cost of Service
item.description: Chinese reports show falling humanoid rental prices, but advertised bargains obscure the staffing and service costs behind commercial deployments.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: XPENG Targets H2 2027 European Rollout for IRON Humanoid Robot
item.description: XPENG’s Paris presentation sets out late-2026 mass production, H1 2027 deliveries and a European rollout in H2 2027, with commercial applications first.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Robotera’s VPP2 Tops RoboDojo Simulation Benchmark by Linking Video Prediction to Robot Actions
item.description: VPP2 leads RoboDojo-Sim with a 32.26% success rate. Robotera has released code and checkpoints, alongside separate results on physical robot manipulation.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Monolithos Seeks Robotics Teams to Test a Memory Layer for Robot Experience
item.description: Founder Silas Yu tells Humanoids Daily how Robot Brain retains and revises experience, and what remains to be tested on physical robots.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Microagi Says It Reached $100 Million Revenue Run Rate in Six Months
item.description: CEO Bercan Kilic links the milestone to Shift’s launch, while Animesh Garg reiterates the company’s ambition to deploy one million robots.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Ultra Raises $50 Million Series A for Warehouse Robots, Deepens Physical Intelligence Partnership
item.description: The round brings announced funding to $62 million including seed capital, as Ultra scales its warehouse robot service and work with Physical Intelligence.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: BYD Humanoid Robot Design Emerges in Patent Images
item.description: Patent images reported by CnEVPost offer a look at BYD’s proposed humanoid, while a formal unveiling and technical specifications remain pending.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: ARC Brings Human-Piloted Humanoid Fights to Singapore
item.description: Professional fighters piloted Unitree G1 and EngineAI T800 robots at ARC’s Singapore event, as REK and UFB pursue their own robot entertainment formats.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Dyna Robotics’ Taku to Join Nasdaq Closing Bell at RoboStrategy Event
item.description: The October 13 event will bring robotics executives and robot demonstrations to New York ahead of a Nasdaq closing-bell appearance.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: From X to San Francisco: Devang Adhyaru Brings Humanoid Hub Together
item.description: Ahead of the October 15–16 Humanoid Hub Conference, Devang Adhyaru discusses bringing robotics offline, the promise of robot hands, and the road to useful home humanoids.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Aether AI Unveils CRIS-0, a Robot AI System That Checks Its Own Actions
item.description: In a written interview, Aether explains how CRIS-0 combines causal prediction with action verification, and why generalization remains its biggest challenge.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Tesla Patent Application Details Flexible Touch Sensors for Robot Hands
item.description: The filing describes curved tactile sensor arrays and ways to manufacture them, offering a likely glimpse into Optimus development without confirming their use in its new hand.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: UBTECH and FAW-Volkswagen Expand Humanoid Robot Partnership Into Factory Logistics
item.description: The companies will develop and test logistics applications, building on Walker S Lite quality-inspection trials at FAW-Volkswagen’s Qingdao plant.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: REK Adds Swords to Humanoid Robot Fights With “Deathmatch”
item.description: Humanoid boxing was apparently just the warm-up. REK’s October 9 Deathmatch adds blade-equipped robots and a Rektile-versus-T-REK main event.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Faraday Future’s “Built in USA” Robot Plan Starts With Assembly—and Sourced Hardware
item.description: FF targets U.S. robot production in February 2027, while its current catalog points to Booster and AGIBOT platforms. Here is what its localization plan establishes.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Mecka Raises $60M Series B to Expand Robot Training Data and Deployment
item.description: The Sequoia-led round includes Nvidia and Microsoft’s M12 as Mecka expands human-demonstration data collection and commercial robot deployment.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)
